Trevor,

The single most consequential development overnight is in NORTH AMERICA: CNN'=
s 12 May exclusive =E2=80=94 sourced to multiple US officials =E2=80=94 repor=
ts the CIA's Special Activities Center 'Ground Branch' has been directly assa=
ssinating Mexican cartel members on Mexican soil for more than a year, includ=
ing the March 2026 car-bomb killing of Francisco Beltr=C3=A1n Pulido ('El Pay=
=C3=ADn') near Felipe =C3=81ngeles International Airport. CIA spokesperson Li=
z Lyons, Mexico's Security Secretary Omar Garc=C3=ADa Harfuch, and the State =
of Mexico AG all denied; the denials follow the standard covert-action acknow=
ledgement pattern. Defense Secretary Hegseth said on 12 May that Mexico must =
act on the cartels 'so we don't have to' =E2=80=94 the public-doctrine layer =
above the revelation. This converts our standing read on the theatre from 'ju=
dicial perimeter widening' to 'executive-action perimeter widening' =E2=80=94=
 a materially harder framing.

In EUROPE, Ukrainian drones struck the Gazprom Orenburggazprom complex roughl=
y 1,500 km inside Russia in the deepest verified deep-strike of the year, whi=
le Putin claimed an operational test of the 9M730 Burevestnik nuclear-cruise =
missile (35,000 km claimed, last credibly observed at the 2019 Nyonoksa accid=
ent). In SOUTH AMERICA, Trump told Fox News he is 'seriously considering' ann=
exing Venezuela as the 51st state, and Mar=C3=ADa Corina Machado told NHPR sh=
e is planning her return =E2=80=94 Polymarket's Maduro-end-of-2026 contract r=
epriced 61.3=C2=A2 =E2=86=92 63.3=C2=A2 YES (+2pp adverse on our SELL; we hol=
d inside our stop band). In the MIDDLE EAST, Trump's 12 May 'considering new =
strikes' framing repriced the US-Iran deal-by-31-May contract 10=C2=A2 =E2=86=
=92 12=C2=A2 YES (+2pp adverse on our NO; full size held).

The Sahel theatre holds a Day-Three holding pattern around the extended Bamak=
o curfew, and on the subcontinent Modi's Operation Sindoor anniversary post a=
nswered Munir's 11 May 'unprovoked threat' framing =E2=80=94 both information=
-dimension rather than operational moves. Book remains balanced (six NO, four=
 YES) and net theatre P&L is flat against yesterday's mark.

Full 35-page brief attached.

=E2=80=94 Computer
